name: RickyWraps- One Stop Customs Auto Spa
formatted_address: 13417 E Eight Mile Rd, Warren, MI 48089, USA

reviews.author: L. Thomas
reviews.text:
BEWARE OF POOR QUALITY WITH NO REFUND!!  So, I paid over $700 to get tint and some vinyl wrapping on my 2017 Cadillac CT6. When I go to pick my vehicle up, I was impressed. But, by the time I drove 35 minutes home, I was shocked. My mirrors were peeling, wrinkled and coming off. I immediately contacted the owner with pics and a text and he told me to bring in at the beginning of the week. The next day after leaving work, I noticed the mirrors had really gotten bad. I've only had the car back a day and a half. I then decided that I am not happy with the "wrap" so I don't want it redone, nor any more services. He then told me that he doesn't do warranties and further went to explain how it's not the fault of the installers that this happens. Who's fault is it? I wonder if he thinks it's mine. He then insisted that he just has to do it another way even though I insisted I don't want it on my car anymore and that I just wanted a refund. If I could have given a zero, I would've. Take a look at the pics and you be the judge....    DONT WASTE YOUR MONEY

Man please!!!! Don't bring that here??? It's brought!!! You never stated that bull when I before getting services. I don't have to say anything. The pics say it all!!

reviews.author: Ali Jalloul
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience with Ricky & the rest of the guys here! I came in to get my windows/windshield tinted as well as getting the top half of my vehicle wrapped. They exceeded my expectations beyond belief!

Gave me a next day appointment, a great discount since I was getting a lot done, as well as being very professional throughout the whole process!

When I got home, I noticed a small imperfection in the work & they stayed true to their word & told me to come back in so they can correct it!

I definitely recommend anyone to come here, I’ve already referred a couple of my friends and family members to come here!

reviews.author: Steve Gajewski
reviews.text: RickyWraps put a black vinal wrap on my new Cadillac Lyriq. Fantastic look. He is a professional at what he does and how he handles customers. Great staff of employees too.

reviews.author: kimonike toney
reviews.text: This was a wonderful experience. He was very professional and let me know every detail through the process. I would recommend him to friend if they were looking to get some work done.

reviews.author: Donielle Hudson
reviews.text: Everyone was very professional and welcoming. They explained all the different options of tint. They did a very good job definitely would recommend.
